justification: Both depict low-relief scenes of robed human figures in strict profile with distinctive headgear, standing on a ground line, which is a real but broad correspondence. A shows a wide architectural panorama with columns, a stepped terrace, a repeated file of identical attendants and a lion-attacking-bull group, while B shows a small closed scene of a few figures confronting one another around a central object with sign-like markings, so the specific combinations and relationships differ almost entirely.
